note: Adapted from the original description of Sjöstedt (1913); the original is in German and covers the soldier and worker; type locality Elisabethville, Katanga, Belgian Congo; the nest is dome-shaped (Nid en dôme).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head red-yellow, not darkening anteriorly, elongate rectangular, the sides straight and slightly convergent posteriorly, the posterior margin arcuate, the width about 2/3 of the length; fontanelle in a large cavity, the cavity large and ringed with dense setae; from the anterior corner of the cavity a distinct groove runs to each mandible; the top of the frons slightly raised and projecting forwards, its anterior margin viewed obliquely from behind forming a slightly flattened arc; labrum forked; mandibles nearly straight, only very slightly curved, more strongly incurved at the tip, about 2/3 of the head length, black with red-yellow base, the two colours sharply demarcated; postmentum band-like, distinctly narrowed behind the middle; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 the smallest and its demarcation often indistinct, segment 1 thick and as long as the 3 segments after it together, segment 2 as long as segments 3 and 4 together, the outer segments elongate-club-shaped, those in the middle of the antenna about 3 times as long as wide, the terminal segments smaller and the last oval; anterior lobe of the pronotum small and curved, the anterior margin not or scarcely concave in the middle. Measurements: body length 6.5, head length including the mandibles 3.83—3.90, head length 2—2.20, head width 1.35—1.40 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellowish white, oval, the sides slightly flattened and narrowed at the mouthparts; a punctiform depression in the middle of the frons; labrum broadly oval, truncate at the front, with a brown dot on each side; first mandibular tooth much larger than the rest; antennae pale, 15-segmented, segment 3 very small and sometimes indistinctly demarcated, segments 4 and 5 equal in size, the outer segments gradually larger, the last the longest and elongate-oval; anterior margin of the pronotum not concave in the middle. Measurements: body length 4.5, head width 1 mm.
